title: Measuring and tuning consumption: `kubectl top`, metrics-server and waste

videos.script: Lesson 19 set requests by guessing. This lesson replaces the guess with a measurement. {{guess}} The kubelet on every node already knows how much CPU and memory each container uses. Nothing collects it until you install metrics-server, which asks every kubelet and serves the answers through the API. {{collect}} Then kubectl top can show you two things side by side: what a pod asked for, and what it uses. {{compare}} The gap between them is waste. A cluster pays for every millicore that is requested, used or not. {{waste}} You will measure the shop idle and under load, and see which of its two requests was wrong, and by how much. {{plan}}
